author: speitzako

sections.description:
The #1 WooCommerce Bulk Editor for managing product prices, inventory, stock, categories, SKU, and promotions!

Product Editor Pro is the most powerful WooCommerce bulk editing and inventory management tool that allows you to mass edit thousands of products instantly or schedule price changes for future dates. Perfect for online stores that need bulk inventory management, mass stock updates, product category organization, SKU management, and automated sales scheduling for Black Friday, Cyber Monday, and seasonal promotions.

Whether you need to bulk update stock quantities, mass edit product prices, organize categories across hundreds of products, or manage SKU codes efficiently – Product Editor Pro handles all WooCommerce bulk operations in seconds instead of hours of manual work.

🚀 Why Choose Product Editor Pro?

  • Bulk Edit Unlimited Products – Mass edit thousands of WooCommerce products, variations, prices, and inventory in one click (Premium)
  • Bulk Inventory Management – Update stock quantities, stock status, and inventory levels for unlimited products instantly (Premium)
  • Bulk Category Management – Add, remove, or replace product categories across hundreds of products at once (Premium)
  • Bulk SKU Editor – Mass update SKU codes with prefix/suffix or find & replace operations (Premium)
  • Schedule Price Changes – Plan Black Friday sales, seasonal pricing, flash sales, and promotions months in advance (Premium)
  • Bulk Stock Updates – Set products in stock, out of stock, or on backorder in seconds (Premium)
  • Mass Product Weight Editor – Update shipping weights for bulk product updates (Premium)
  • Save Hours of Manual Work – What takes days of manual editing, Product Editor does in seconds with bulk operations
  • Zero Risk Bulk Updates – Transactional updates ensure all-or-nothing changes (no partial updates or data corruption)
  • 50 Undo Operations – Rollback any bulk price change, stock update, or category edit with a single click (Premium)
  • HPOS Compatible – Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage and latest WooCommerce versions

💰 Perfect For

  • Black Friday & Cyber Monday Sales – Bulk schedule flash sales and mass discount updates months in advance
  • Seasonal Pricing & Promotions – Automate bulk price changes for holidays, summer sales, winter clearance
  • Bulk Inventory Management – Mass update stock quantities after inventory counts, manage stock levels efficiently
  • Product Category Organization – Bulk add/remove categories like “New Arrivals”, “Clearance”, “Best Sellers” to hundreds of products
  • SKU Management & Standardization – Mass update SKU codes, add prefixes for new seasons (2026-), find & replace supplier codes
  • Bulk Discounts & Price Reductions – Apply percentage discounts to entire product categories in one click
  • Stock Level Management – Set products out of stock, in stock, or on backorder for discontinued or restocked items
  • Sale Management & Automation – Start and end promotional sales automatically with scheduled bulk updates
  • Price Optimization & Testing – Quickly test different price points across categories to optimize revenue
  • Multi-Store & Multi-Product Operations – Manage prices, inventory, and categories across hundreds of products efficiently
  • Dropshipping & Supplier Updates – Bulk update prices and stock when supplier catalogs change

  • ⭐ SCHEDULE PRICE CHANGES – Plan future price updates (set date & time)

Black Friday Preparation
Schedule price reductions 3 months in advance. On Black Friday morning, all prices update automatically.

Set up 24-hour flash sales with automatic start and end times. No manual intervention needed.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to WordPress admin → Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Product Editor Pro”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Go to Products → Product Editor to start

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to WordPress admin → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to Products → Product Editor

After Installation

  1. Navigate to Products → Product Editor in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for products using filters (category, tags, SKU, etc.)
  3. Select products you want to edit
  4. Configure the changes (prices, sale dates, tags)
  5. Apply immediately or schedule for a future date (Premium)
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with the latest WooCommerce?

Yes! Product Editor Pro is fully compatible with WooCommerce 9.0+ including HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).

Can I schedule price changes for Black Friday?

Yes! The Premium version allows you to schedule price changes for any future date and time. Perfect for Black Friday, Cyber Monday, and seasonal sales.

What happens if I edit more than 50 products in the free version?

The free version limits bulk edits to 50 products per operation. Upgrade to Premium for unlimited product editing.

Can I undo bulk changes?

Yes! The free version keeps the last 3 operations that can be undone. Premium version keeps 50 undo operations.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes! Product Editor Pro fully supports simple products, variable products (and their variations), and external products.

If I refresh the page during a bulk update, will products be partially updated?

No! All changes are transactional. Either all products update successfully or none do. You’ll never have partial updates.

Can I increase prices by a percentage?

Yes! You can increase or decrease prices by:
– Fixed amount (e.g., +$5)
– Percentage (e.g., +20%)
– Multiply by value (e.g., ×1.5)
– Set to specific value

Can I filter products by custom taxonomies?

Yes! You can search and filter products by any custom taxonomy, not just standard categories and tags.

Does it send notifications when scheduled tasks complete?

Yes, in the Premium version you receive email notifications when scheduled price changes are executed.

Can I try Premium features before buying?

Yes! Premium version includes a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start.

Is my data safe?

Absolutely! The plugin uses WordPress and WooCommerce’s native APIs. All updates are transactional and can be undone.

Does it work on multisite?

Yes, Product Editor Pro is compatible with WordPress multisite installations.

Can I schedule recurring price changes?

Currently, each scheduled task runs once. For recurring changes, you can create multiple scheduled tasks.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept PayPal, Stripe (credit cards), and other major payment methods through our secure checkout.

Do you offer refunds?

Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee if you’re not satisfied with the Premium version.

Can I bulk edit stock quantities for all products?

Yes! The Premium version allows you to mass update stock quantities for unlimited products. You can set stock to a specific number, increase by amount, or decrease by amount across all selected products.

How do I bulk update product categories in WooCommerce?

With Premium, select your products and use the bulk category editor to add categories, remove specific categories, or replace all categories at once. Perfect for organizing hundreds of products into “New Arrivals”, “Sale Items”, or seasonal collections.

Can I mass edit SKU codes for multiple products?

Yes! Premium includes bulk SKU editing with options to: set new SKU, add prefix (e.g., “2026-“), add suffix, or find & replace SKU patterns across your entire product catalog.

How to bulk change stock status to out of stock?

Select products in the bulk editor, choose “Stock Status”, select “Out of Stock”, and apply. All selected products will be marked as out of stock instantly. Premium feature.

Can I bulk edit product weights for shipping?

Yes! Premium version includes bulk weight editing. Set weights to specific values, increase by amount, or decrease by amount for accurate shipping calculations across all products.

Does this work with WooCommerce variable products and variations?

Absolutely! Product Editor Pro fully supports simple products, variable products, and all their variations. You can bulk edit variation prices, stock, SKU, and more.

How to schedule bulk price changes for future dates?

In Premium, configure your price changes, then click “Schedule” instead of “Apply Now”. Set your desired date and time, and the bulk updates will execute automatically.

Can I bulk update inventory levels after stock count?

Yes! Use the bulk stock quantity editor to update inventory levels for hundreds or thousands of products at once. Much faster than manual updates in WooCommerce.

Is there a limit on how many products I can bulk edit?

Free version: 50 products per operation. Premium version: Unlimited products – edit thousands of products in a single bulk operation.
